title: Colorado Hospital Discounted Care (HB 21-1198)
asOf: As described by the Department of Health Care Policy and Financing (HCPF)

rules.title: Hospital Discounted Care at or under 250% FPL
rules.plain: Colorado hospitals must screen you and limit your hospital and doctor bills if your household income is at or below 250% of the poverty line, even if you have insurance.
rules.quote: Patients who are at or below 250% of the Federal Poverty Guidelines (FPG) are eligible for Hospital Discounted Care.
rules.notes: Bills are limited to rates set by HCPF. Insured patients must ask to be screened; uninsured patients are screened unless they opt out. The program is for Colorado residents; hospitals may extend it.

rules.title: Monthly payments capped by income
rules.short: If you qualify, monthly payments are capped at 4% of your income for hospital bills, and you owe nothing after 36 payments
rules.plain: If you qualify, monthly hospital payments can't be more than 4% of your monthly household income (2% for each doctor's bill), and you owe nothing more after 36 monthly payments.
rules.quote: Monthly payments for hospital bills can’t be more than 4% of your monthly household income.

rules.title: Written notice before collections
rules.short: 30 days' written notice before collections, and your insurance must be billed first
rules.plain: Before sending your bill to collections, the biller must explain the charges, bill your insurance first, and tell you in writing 30 days ahead.
rules.quote: Tell you in writing 30 days before they send you to collections.
